subject: Communication Systems
questionText:
What will be the channel bandwidth required if 
rectangular pulse shapes are used? 
 
(a)  75.6 MHz 
(b)  8.4 MHz 
 
(c)  933.3 kHz 
(d)  17.4 MHz 
 
Common Data For 30 and 31 : 
Compact disk (CD) players use 16-bit PCM, including one 
parity bit with 8 times oversampling of the analog signal. 
The analog signal bandwidth is 20 kHz.
explanation: Practice Question from Communication Systems DPP-05 (ECE/IN).
